title: Regenerate and verify release reference artifacts
scope: Pin the full reference-document toolchain and regenerate PDF/layout artifacts for the reviewed contract.
acceptance: Text, generated C headers, coverage and PDF/layout refer to the same registry revision.
A clean documented command reproduces artifacts or reports known nondeterminism.
evidence: PASS: python tools/reference/bootstrap.py --build --check --skip-vulkan-header; CPython 3.13.15/MSVC 19.51 on Windows GTX 1080 host; all 10 artifacts reproduced byte-for-byte and docs/roadmap/evidence/F6-05-reference-artifacts.json records the reviewed result.
